summary: Second Studio run today: remade the credit-card minimum-payment video (L-20261019-01, deleted by the owner this evening for the new look) with the new bill, road, fork and source scenes. Script and fact review passed, but the last allowed re-render failed the layout gate, so the video is marked failed and nothing shipped.
why: studio.md allows two re-renders. Render 1 failed the gates (6 s still on a reveal beat, receipt text off-frame). Render 2 passed the gates (277 s, liveliness 1.98, audio -1.0/-17.2 dB) but QA failed it on five layout points. Render 3 fixed those but the stack prop's figure '$11,638' left the frame at 131.7 s. A failed video beats shipping a broken one.

findings.title: Fact review passed on the second try
findings.detail: First pass caught a wrong 'late fees on top' line for an on-time payer and a US-only CTA; both fixed. 22.2% APR backed by Fed G.19 (22.36% Aug 2026); Reg Z 1026.7(b)(12) statement lines confirmed; CFPB: ~15% paid only the minimum in 2024.

findings.title: Scene bugs found by the gates and QA
findings.detail: Stack prop kicker/figure overlap and off-frame figure; road signs overflow with long labels; presenter x:0 cuts actors in half; prop text must be a figure. Logged in improvement/longform/backlog.json for the improver.
